message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CMake

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

env:
  # Customize the CMake build type here (Release, Debug, RelWithDebInfo, etc.)
  BUILD_TYPE: Release

jobs:
  build:
    # The CMake configure and build commands are platform agnostic and should work equally well on Windows or Mac.
    # You can convert this to a matrix build if you need cross-platform coverage.
    # See: https://docs.github.com/en/free-pro-team@latest/actions/learn-github-actions/managing-complex-workflows#using-a-build-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: boost
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -yq libboost-all-dev libfl-dev libssl-dev rapidjson-dev
      
    - name: Configure CMake
      # Configure CMake in a 'build' subdirectory. `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE` is only required if you are using a single-configuration generator such as make.
      # See https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/variable/CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE.html?highlight=cmake_build_type
      run: cmake -B ${{github.workspace}}/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{env.BUILD_TYPE}}

    - name: Build
      # Build your program with the given configuration
      run: cmake --build ${{github.workspace}}/build --config ${{env.BUILD_TYPE}}

    - name: Zone references
      run: python3 ${{github.workspace}}/vme/scripts/check_zone_refs.py --baseline ${{github.workspace}}/vme/scripts/zone_refs_baseline.txt

    - name: VME Unit Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin
      run: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin/vme_unit_tests --color_output=false --log_level=message

    - name: VMC Unit Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin
      run: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin/vmc_unit_tests --color_output=false --log_level=message

    - name: Defcomp Unit Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin
      run: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin/defcomp_unit_tests --color_output=false --log_level=message

    - name: MPlex2 Unit Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin
      run: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin/mplex_unit_tests --color_output=false --log_level=message

    - name: PP Unit Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin
      run: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin/pp_unit_tests --color_output=false --log_level=message

    - name: VME Integration Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin
      run: ${{github.workspace}}/vme/bin/intergration_test.sh",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a single CMake build/test job on every push and pull request to master, with no matrix, schedule, or Bazel steps, so most patterns do not apply. The CI history shows rapid successive pushes to the same branch (e.g., 12:38:20 and 12:38:35; 11:29:45 and 11:29:56), meaning older in-progress runs are frequently superseded by newer revisions. Adding a job-level concurrency group keyed by workflow and ref with cancel-in-progress cancels superseded runs of the same branch/PR while isolating distinct branches, preserving every build and test step. This matches P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs), whose preconditions are met: runs represent the same workflow and branch/PR, and a newer revision supersedes older checks. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or network access are added, and no publishing/deployment operations are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
